ModMetaData.name: SadSeal's Gene Synthesizer
ModMetaData.author: SadSeal5 / Ramo
ModMetaData.description:
SadSeal's Gene Synthesizer empowers you to synthesize and craft any gene in RimWorld at the Gene Assembler in exchange for Neutroamine.
Features: - Craft any gene from Vanilla Biotech and ANY installed mods! - Real-time gene browser dialog with search, category filtering, and mod filtering. - Displays biostats (complexity, metabolism, archite) and detailed descriptions. - Fully customizable in Mod Settings: adjust Neutroamine cost, crafting labor ticks, instant crafting, and Archite capsule rules. - Quick presets: Free, Cheap (25), Standard (100), Hardcore (250), or custom values. - Seamless pawn workflow: Haul Neutroamine to the assembler, then intellectual pawns perform synthesis to produce a standalone Genepack. - Full English and Turkish (Türkçe) localization.
